author: intothevoid4
body:
intothevoid4
advertising
The reason I was banned was because I typed l.joim in chat twice. I was trying to type /join but made a typo. Initially I didn't care all that much as I wasn't playing on the servers very regularly so I didn't appeal but now a lot of my friends are playing on Avicus more I'd like to try and get unbanned. I have talked with the mod that banned me (Emmaye) and he agrees it was probably a mistake on his part but he cannot appeal as he is no longer a mod. Even if you believe none of this it has been over a year since I got the punishment  and i would really hope for a second chance! 
Thanks
